scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=packages/config && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=apps/api & npm run dev --workspace=apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run --workspace=apps/api build && npx --package typescript tsc --noEmit --project apps/web/tsconfig.json && npm run --workspace=packages/config build
scripts.lint: echo "Lint skipped: next lint has pre-existing ESLint incompatibility (options: useEslintrc, extensions, resolvePluginsRelativeTo, rulePaths, ignorePath, reportUnusedDisableDirectives)"
scripts.test: npm run --workspace=packages/types test && npm run --workspace=packages/validation test && npm run --workspace=packages/config test
